basic_details.job_title: HAL Management & Design Trainee Recruitment 2026 (Short Notice) - Apply Online for 120 Posts
basic_details.job_type: Central Government PSU Job (Maharatna CPSE, Ministry of Defence)
basic_details.short_information: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has released a short recruitment notice inviting applications for Design Trainee (DT) and Management Trainee (MT) posts across its various Divisions, Research & Design Centres, and Offices. A total of 120 vacancies are on offer, and interested candidates can apply online from 29 July 2026 through the official HAL website.

how_to_apply: Visit the official HAL website: www.hal-india.co.in
Download and read the detailed advertisement carefully once released.
Click on the online application link.
Register and fill out the application form with correct details.
Upload required documents and photographs as specified.
Pay the application fee, if applicable.
Submit the form within the window of 29-07-2026 (1400 hrs) to 14-08-2026 (1400 hrs) and take a printout for future reference.
important_instructions: Applications can be submitted only online between 29-07-2026 (1400 hrs) and 14-08-2026 (1400 hrs). Any corrigendum or addendum will be hosted only on the official HAL website.

Candidates from Aeronautical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Computer Science, Metallurgy, Production, and Civil engineering backgrounds can also explore more (#) Engineering Government Jobs and (#) PSU Recruitment 2026 openings. Those interested in Defence sector careers can check (#) Ministry of Defence Jobs and (#) Bengaluru Government Jobs for more opportunities in a similar domain.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for HAL Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Design Trainee (DT): Candidates from Aeronautical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Computer Science, or Metallurgy disciplines. Specific qualification criteria are not specified in this short notice. Management Trainee (MT): Candidates from Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Computer Science, Metallurgy, Production, or Civil disciplines. Specific qualification criteria are not specified in this short notice.
